title: Mission breaking-change catalog
$comment: Versionable, CI-testable catalog of breaking changes for a named mission upgrade path. Validated by src/scripts/lint_missions.py. Commands in fix/detection blocks are restricted to a safe-prefix allowlist — schema validation replaces a runtime security audit (council, 2026-06-15).

version.description: Catalog schema version (major.minor). Bump minor for additive entries, major for structural changes.

to.description: Target major version (integer string, e.g. '11'). Must be greater than 'from'.

breaking_changes.description: Ordered list of breaking changes. The mission engine iterates these in order during the fix phase.

safe_command.description: Shell command string restricted to safe prefixes: composer, php, php artisan, git, sed, rector, vendor/bin/*. Schema validation is the security gate — the linter enforces this pattern on every command field (council, 2026-06-15).

notes.description: Optional additional guidance, caveats, or context.

id.description: Unique slug within this catalog (used as a checkpoint key in .work-state.json).

title.description: One-line description of the breaking change.

severity.description: Impact severity. 'critical' = breaks boot or data integrity; 'high' = broad API breakage; 'medium' = targeted fixup; 'low' = behavioral nuance.

detection.description: How to detect whether this change affects the project.

fix.description: How to apply the fix (may reference a Rector rule or manual step).

verification.description: How to verify the fix is complete and correct.

references.description: Upstream documentation or upgrade guide URLs.

rector_rule.description: Optional Rector rule class name that automates this fix (e.g. 'RenameClassRector').
